description: This file defines classes, functions, and decorators related to exporting and managing cases for torch models, including support levels, validation, registration, and conversion to snake case.

classes.name: SupportLevel
classes.description: Enum indicating the stage at which a feature is handled in export.

classes.name: ExportCase
classes.description: Dataclass representing an export case for a torch model, including args, description, tags, and support level.

methods.name: check_inputs_type
methods.description: Validates that args is a tuple and kwargs is a dict with string keys.

methods.name: _validate_tag
methods.description: Validates that a tag string contains only allowed characters and is registered.

methods.name: register_db_case
methods.description: Registers an ExportCase into the internal database, handling conflicts.

methods.name: to_snake_case
methods.description: Converts a CamelCase name to snake_case.

methods.name: _make_export_case
methods.description: Creates an ExportCase instance from a model, name, and configs, ensuring the model is a torch.nn.Module.

methods.name: export_case
methods.description: Decorator for registering a user-provided export case.

methods.name: export_rewrite_case
methods.description: Decorator for registering a rewrite of an existing export case.
